examples.en: My mother stir-fried eggplant for me at lunch.

examples.ko: 저는 어릴 때 가지는 안 먹었어요.
examples.en: When I was little, I didn't eat eggplant.
Fresh eggplants were on sale cheap at the market.

examples.ko: 냉장고에 있는 가지로 무슨 반찬을 만들까요?
examples.en: What side dish shall we make with the eggplant in the fridge?

examples.ko: 가지 한 개를 길게 반으로 잘라 주세요.
examples.en: Please cut one eggplant in half lengthwise.
I planted eggplants and also chili peppers in the field.

explain: 보라색 채소이고 '가지나물', '가지볶음'처럼 반찬 이름에 많이 나와요. 나무의 '가지', '한 가지'의 '가지'와 소리가 같아요. '가지고 가다'의 '가지다'는 또 다른 동사예요.

phrases.en: The seasoned eggplant my mother made is delicious.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가지를 쪄서 양념에 무친 반찬을 말할 때 쓴다.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for the side dish made of steamed eggplant seasoned by hand.

explain_en: It is a purple vegetable that appears in side-dish names like '가지나물' and '가지볶음'. It sounds the same as '가지' (branch) and '가지' in '한 가지' (one kind). The '가지다' in '가지고 가다' is yet another, separate verb.

examples.en: A bird is sitting on the tree branch.
The wind blew hard and the branch broke.
The child shook the branch and the fruit fell.
When spring comes, flowers bloom on every branch.

examples.ko: 높은 가지 끝에 감이 달려 있어요.
examples.en: A persimmon is hanging at the tip of the high branch.

examples.ko: 저 가지는 너무 높아서 손이 안 닿아요.
examples.en: That branch is so high that I can't reach it.

explain: '나뭇가지'처럼 붙여서도 많이 써요. 나무에서 굵게 뻗은 것은 '줄기', 거기서 갈라져 나온 것이 '가지'예요. '한 가지, 두 가지'의 '가지'(kind)와 모양이 같으니 앞뒤 말을 보세요.

phrases.ko: 가지 많은 나무에 바람 잘 날 없다
phrases.example: 아이가 넷이라 늘 걱정이 많으시대요. 가지 많은 나무에 바람 잘 날 없다더니 맞는 말이에요.
phrases.en: She has four kids and always has something to worry about. They say a tree with many branches never has a calm day, and it's true.
phrases.nuance_ko: 자식이 많은 부모는 걱정이 끊이지 않는다는 속담이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A proverb meaning that parents with many children never run out of worries.

explain_en: It is often written as one word, as in '나뭇가지'. The thick part of a tree is the '줄기' (trunk or stem), and what splits off from it is a '가지'. It looks the same as '가지' (kind) in '한 가지, 두 가지', so check the surrounding words.
